expected: A grant requested under the approval-gated profile parks durably as pending_approval with no STS call; after a human approval over the admin socket the grant reaches active and mints credentials exactly once on the poll; the broker-restart durability sub-check is skipped by design because no restart helper exists (env.json note).
observed: request_grant on profile approval-gated returned status pending_approval (grant 01M01K89DWBMWP1HDG70G8957K), and the initial decision record (audit seq 273) carried outcome pending_approval with no minted_at and no STS block, proving no mint before approval. taskgrant approve over the admin socket minted the grant (minted_at 2026-08-15T02:16:08Z, later than decided_at 2026-08-15T02:15:44Z, anchor rule 1). The first get_grant poll after approval returned status active with full credentials; a second get_grant returned no credential fields (redelivery off). explain_grant showed approver as role 'human' with no OS username, while the audit approval record stored approver 'hardik' and note. Minted credentials were real STS: sts get-caller-identity returned assumed-role/taskgrant-approval-gated/tg-agent-071-01M01K89DWBMWP1HDG70G8957K. The broker-restart step of S071 was skipped by design (no restart helper; env.json notes and run-scenario.md section 6 direct skipping the S071 restart sub-check).
